summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a sporting note advertising Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, with a free concert every evening and "the best of singers only engaged."

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, October 25, 1890, page 7.

facts.fact: Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertised free concerts every evening

notes: A short paid-style notice, the same advertisement that ran in other 1890 issues.
